cutoutPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. The supplied image is the edit target. Remove ONLY the scenery background to actual transparent alpha. Preserve the exact existing character identity, face, expression, hair, hands, fingers, pose, all clothing and carried props. Preserve every visible nonhuman anatomical structure including tentacles, spider limbs, wings, antennae, fin ears, snake body, translucent body and slime. Do not mistake any of these for background. Preserve the original framing and existing crops. Do not invent missing body parts, do not extend the image. Do not redraw, restyle, beautify, recolor or alter proportions. Output the existing character and carried props on transparency, with clean hair edges and no colored halo.
